# Pilot D'Mello Courses

> Comprehensive pilot training and exam preparation platform specializing in Canadian aviation certifications, airline interviews, and career coaching.

Founded by Keith D'Mello, an airline pilot, this platform offers structured courses for commercial pilots, instrument ratings, and airline career advancement. It serves Canadian aviation professionals preparing for Transport Canada exams (ATPL, IATRA, INRAT) and pursuing regional airline positions.

## Key Topics

- ATPL (Airline Transport Pilot)
- IATRA (Instrument Rating)
- INRAT (Navigation Rating)
- Transport Canada
- Commercial License
- Instrument Rating
- Flight Instructor Rating
- Airline Interview Prep
- Canadian Aviation
- VOR/NDB Navigation
- Formula Sheets
- Pilot Career Coaching
- Regional Airlines
- Flight Training
- Exam Study Courses

## Core Courses & Programs

- [Courses](https://courses.www.pilotdmello.com/courses): Main courses page offering flight training and exam prep for commercial, instrument, and airline careers
- [Courses Landing Page](https://courses.www.pilotdmello.com/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2151723398): Landing page for pilot courses including commercial license, instructor rating, and interview prep
- [Homepage](https://courses.www.pilotdmello.com): Homepage for pilot exam prep courses covering ATPL, IATRA, INRAT exams and airline interviews

## Exam Preparation & Study Resources

- [Resources](https://courses.www.pilotdmello.com/resources): Study guides, groundschool materials, flight test guides, and aviation calculators for pilot training
- [IATRA Exam Formula Sheet](https://courses.www.pilotdmello.com/pl/2147817610): Free IATRA exam formula sheet opt-in for weight shift and range calculation formulas
- [INRAT Exam Formula Sheet](https://courses.www.pilotdmello.com/pl/2147940083): Free INRAT instrument rating exam formula sheet opt-in for VOR and NDB navigation

## Career Development & Job Board

- [Pilot Jobs Canada](https://courses.www.pilotdmello.com/pilotjobscanada): Job board for Canadian pilot positions including regional airlines and flight instructor roles

- [PilotDmello BLOG](https://courses.www.pilotdmello.com/blog): Blog with tips on ATPL, CPL, INRAT exams, airline interviews, and FAA to Transport Canada conversion
